Chapter 306 - 306 Triggered; Watch The Experiment!

Chapter 306 - 306 Triggered; Watch the Experiment!

306 Triggered; Watch the Experiment!

The next day, the weather was clear.

Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz, facing the cool morning breeze as he continued forward.

Soon, he arrived at Jiangbei University.

It was the old professor’s class in the morning.

Even though Lin Fan had rested well yesterday, listening to the old professor’s slow, lullaby-like lecture, he quickly fell asleep on the table.

Regarding this…

Not only was the old professor not angry, but he even nodded at Lin Fan.

That look seemed to be saying, ‘He’s the model of a good student!’

After the bell rang, the morning class ended.

Lin Fan, Song Yi, Ma Zhong, and Zheng Jinbao walked out together.

When the four of them walked to a corner up ahead, they accidentally bumped into a middle-aged professor with slightly white hair.

Suddenly, the stack of documents in the middle-aged professor’s hands fell to the ground.

“I’m sorry, Professor…” Ma Zhong hurriedly said.

Then, he squatted down to pick up the information.

Lin Fan, Zheng Jinbao, and Song Yi also bent down to help.

The middle-aged professor was very amiable and said, “It’s okay… I was thinking about something while walking and wasn’t paying attention to what was in front of me.”

When Lin Fan picked up some of the documents, he casually glanced at the information.

Negative: 4Li-4e =4Li+

Positive pole: 2SOCI2 + 4e = 4CI-S +SO2

Total reaction: 4Li+2SOCI2 = 4LiCI2 +S+ S02

…

“Thank you,” said the middle-aged professor.

Ma Zhong had obviously seen the information as well. He could not help but ask, “Professor, are you doing a battery research project?”

Their conversation was very short, but Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

In his mind… a clear notification suddenly sounded.

[Ding! Mission triggered: Watch a battery experiment (0/1). Read Battery Principles, Battery Handbook, Lithium-ion Batteries, Polymer Batteries, and Battery Structure and Principles (0/5). Reward: A super battery patent, manufacturing principle, and complete thesis.]

The middle-aged professor took the materials and turned to leave.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “Professor, may I know your name?”

“My surname is Zhao,” the middle-aged professor said.

“Hello, Professor Zhao. I’m Lin Fan from the Mathematics Department. I’m also interested in batteries. Can you take me to the laboratory to have a look? It would be best if you’ll let me watch the specific experiment,” Lin Fan said.

In fact…

When Professor Zhao saw Lin Fan for the first time, he felt that he was familiar.

After hearing Lin Fan’s self-introduction, his eyes lit up.

Lin Fan from the Mathematics Department…

It could be said that everyone at Jiangbei University had heard of this name!

It was just that Lin Fan never accepted interviews. Many people did not know what he looked like.

Professor Zhao had only seen Lin Fan from afar once. Otherwise, he would have recognized Lin Fan immediately.

Professor Zhao did not hesitate at all and hurriedly said, “Alright, I’ll take you to the laboratory now.”

His experiment topic was considered confidential.

Lin Fan was just a mathematics student.

However, so what?

One had to know…

Lin Fan had even developed an earthquake prediction device!

He was not a physics student!

With a smart brain, no matter what he did, he would be able to achieve twice the result with half the effort and discover things that ordinary people could not detect.

Hence, Professor Zhao could not wait to bring Lin Fan into the lab.

He no longer paid attention to Ma Zhong, Zheng Jinbao, and Song Yi, who were standing on the spot.

After passing through the basketball court, there was a tall building in front of them.

Many chemistry laboratories were located in this building.

Walking along the wide corridor of the building, one could hear a dull sound from afar.

Professor Zhao took the lead and pushed open the laboratory door.

A tall machine came into view.

Three graduate students were working on something seriously.

Even when they heard the door open, they did not turn around to look.

Only the old professor, who was sitting at the front and staring at the computer screen, raised his head.

He first looked at Professor Zhao calmly, then glanced at Lin Fan. He did not say anything and turned his attention back to the computer screen.

Professor Zhao took the initiative to introduce, “Professor Li, this is Lin Fan from the Mathematics Department.”

“Oh?” Professor Li’s face, which had always been calm, was now filled with surprise.

The three graduate students who had been focused on the experiment could not help but stop what they were doing and turn around to look.

Lin Fan’s reputation in Jiangbei University was simply too big.

Professor Zhao continued, “Lin Fan is also very interested in batteries. He came today to visit the laboratory and see the specific battery experiments.”

Professor Li did not hesitate and said, “Alright! We still have some unfinished tasks from our last experiment. Please wait a while.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

As expected, he only waited for a while.

About five minutes later, Professor Li said, “Our battery experiment can start again.”

“I’ll have to trouble you, Professor Li,” Lin Fan said.

Professor Li smiled. “It’s not troublesome at all. It’s what we do.”

Then, Professor Li said, “Everyone, try to do the experiment as carefully as possible and set the standard!”

Clearly, he wanted Lin Fan to understand more.

As the experiment began, a dull sound came from the strange-looking machine.

Rows of indicator lights lit up with different lights.

Then, electric sparks kept jumping in the pitch-black material, making crackling sounds.

At the same time, a jumping curve appeared on the computer screen.

The three graduate students moved very slowly. Moreover, some of the operations that could have been skipped were carried out.

Therefore, the experiment that originally only needed 30 minutes lasted for nearly 50 minutes before it slowly ended.

Professor Li first took some notes on the experiment.

Then, he asked, “Lin Fan, how was it? Do you have any other thoughts? Or suggestions?”

Lin Fan looked at the system mission.

[Mission: Watch a battery experiment (1/1). Read Battery Principles, Battery Handbook, Lithium-ion Batteries, Polymer Batteries, and Battery Structure and Principles (0/5). Reward: A super battery patent, manufacturing principle, and complete thesis.]

Obviously, the first condition of the mission had been fulfilled.

Thus, Lin Fan said, “I need to spend some time thinking about it.”

Professor Li was not too surprised. He nodded and said, “Batteries indeed require a lot of time and experiments to achieve certain results.”
